name: Church Pool Services

hero.title: Pool pump and pool filter repair
hero.lead: Church Pool Services is the only call you have to make. Church Pool Services has expert technicians in pool services. We can evaluate your problem, recommend an effective solution and get the job done quickly.

summary: Church Pool Services offers pool pump repair, pool filter repair and cartridge filters across Houston, Katy and Sugar Land.

groups.title: Pool Pump Repair
groups.summary: No matter what company manufactured your pool pump, motor or sanitizer, we can fix it.
groups.intro: No matter what company manufactured your pool pump, motor or sanitizer, we can fix it. Whether you have a Hayward, Pentair, Jandy or any other brand name, the expert technicians at Church Pool Services can get your pool pump running again.

groups.title: Pool Filter Repair
groups.summary: Church Pool Services can repair, clean and replace all makes and models of pool filters, whether you have a cartridge, sand or diatomaceous earth (DE) filter. Most manufacturers recommend cleaning your filters twice a year to keep them working at their best.

groups.title: Cartridge Filters
groups.summary: Cartridge filters are pretty simple to operate and were originally created for smaller pools and spas.
groups.intro: Cartridge filters are pretty simple to operate and were originally created for smaller pools and spas. But with new innovations, they’ve been installed in much larger swimming pools and can last up to five years. Typically, cartridge filters are cleaned with a high-pressure hose to remove trapped particles.

groups.title: Diatomaceous Earth, or De, Filters
groups.summary: Diatomaceous earth, or DE, filters have been some of the most popular filters for residential swimming pools because they’re effective at stopping particles down to 3–5 microns. The power of this filter is in the powder, which is made up of the microscopic skeletons of very old subaquatic creatures called diatoms.

groups.title: Pool Heater Repair
groups.summary: Swimming pool heaters are a complex combination of parts and systems running on both electricity and natural gas to keep your pool warm during the cooler months. Over the years, corrosion, debris, ventilation issues, and blockage can cause your swimming pool heater to malfunction or break down.

about.title: About Church Pool Services
text: Chris Church, a native Houstonian, has been in the residential services business for over 30 years. In 2016 Chris acquired a pool cleaning, service, and remodeling company and created a residential outdoor services company, Church Pool Services. This company is a Church Family Company that focuses on competitive pricing, extraordinary service and being customer-centered in everything we do.

Because Church Pool Services is locally owned and managed, we understand Houston’s fickle weather and climate and are ready to tackle whatever Mother Nature throws our way. We will work out the best maintenance schedule for your pool and are ready to help with any service or remodeling project your pool might need.
